answer: Like crystallization, an agent economy resists Sybil attacks by anchoring identity to decentralized graph consensus. Each honest vertex seeds verifiable trust, acting like a sturdy jetty that breaks spam surges before they diffuse into a chaotic nebula of clones. By enforcing transitive proof-of-stake validation across peer bonds, attacker cost scales superlinear to swarm size, making mass spoofing economically ruinous.
